rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The head of state took part online in the presidential election; the item states that the election of the President of the Russian Federation is being held from 15 to 17 March, for the first time over three days and with remote electronic voting in almost a third of the regions.
